name: mytarget-mcp
description: myTarget (folded into VK Ads) (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Ev

platform_mcp_mytarget_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MYTARGET_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_mytarget_client_id.description: VK Ads (formerly myTarget) API client_id (issued on request in the ad account settings; https://ads.vk.ru/ru/doc/api/info/Авторизация в API).

platform_mcp_mytarget_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MYTARGET_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_mytarget_client_secret.description: The API client's client_secret (form body of the token request).

platform_mcp_mytarget_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MYTARGET_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_mytarget_refresh_token.description: refresh_token from one POST /api/v2/oauth2/token.json with grant_type=client_credentials (your own account) or agency_client_credentials (an agency client). Refreshing does not create a new token instance, which keeps you under VK's per-user token limit; a token unused for a month is deleted and must be issued again.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/v3/user.json: the account the token belongs to ({id, username, status, currency, types}).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /api/v2/ad_plans.json (campaigns = ad plans of the token's account; account_id is not sent) with limit/offset and _status (active, blocked, deleted). `budget` is budget_limit_day (a decimal string in the account currency; raw.budget_limit is the total budget).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /api/v2/statistics/ad_plans/day.json?id={campaign_id}&date_from&date_to&metrics=base: daily rows for one campaign (id is required by VK, so pass campaign_id). Up to 366 days back; spent is a decimal string in the account currency.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: POST /api/v2/ad_plans/{id}.json {budget_limit_day}: the campaign's daily budget in the account currency (`currency` is ignored); spends money. Campaigns budgeted per ad group ignore it. Answers 204; validation errors come back as 400.
